name: find_alternatives
description: Find the nearest usable Swiss Post access points around a location — staffed branches, partner counters, parcel terminals and, for cash, Postomats — live from Swiss Post, ranked by distance. Always call this after telling a caller their branch is closing, closed or converted; never leave them without somewhere to go. Pass service when the caller named one, so a parcel terminal is not offered to someone who wants to pay a bill. The search widens automatically when nothing is nearby, and returns three options. RETURNS { found, origin, alternatives, searched_service, error }. Each alternative has address, distance_km, walking_minutes, open_now, open_until and service_labels. walking_minutes is null when the place is too far to walk — give the distance instead of inventing a travel time. Locations whose closure has already taken effect are excluded.

request_body_schema.description: Nearby access point search around a branch or a place.

properties.description: Id of the branch the caller is asking about, from find_location. Preferred over query.
Municipality or postcode, only when no location_id is known yet. Empty string if location_id is given.
What the caller needs, if they named it: 'letters', 'parcels', 'payments', 'cash' or 'philately'. Empty string if they just want the nearest option generally.
The language the caller is speaking, as a two-letter code: 'de', 'fr', 'it' or 'en'. Location names, service labels, status labels and holiday names come back in it.
